# secrets-precommit

> Fast secret detector for pre-commit hooks in Go: ten RE2 rules, JSON team rules, entropy checks, allowlists and output that never prints a secret Go module `github.com/Trysac/u071-secrets-precommit`, package `secretsprecommit`, MIT licensed,
> Go >= 1.23, standard library only.
